backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use the same exp-20260510-028 augmented snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260511-105 policy semantics.

before_variant.description: accepted exp-20260511-105 semantics: PL/BKSY trend_long keeps the broad official Space 5 ATR target

best_variant.description: only PL/BKSY data-vendor trend_long signals use a 6 ATR target; all accepted Space risk scalars and other targets remain locked

decision_rationale: PL/BKSY data-vendor trend target widening did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. The current evidence supports keeping data-vendor trend targets at the broad 5 ATR official Space setting.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; accepted changes remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: exit/capital lifecycle alpha: widen only PL/BKSY data-vendor trend_long targets inside the accepted Space stack.

2_history_check.exp-20260511-018: Deleting PL/BKSY breakouts by trend-only gating was rejected.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-031: PL/BKSY breakout risk haircut to 0.1x was accepted.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-038: Excluding data-vendor trend from the broad 5 ATR target was rejected.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-109: PL/BKSY data-vendor trend risk scalar helped only old_thin and was rejected.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-110: Space breakout stop widening was rejected; this is not a breakout geometry retry.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_data_vendor_trend_target_atr_mult; no candidate pool, risk scalar, ranking, add-on, or LLM boundary changes.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, EV improvement in at least 2/3 windows with no EV-regressed window, drawdown max delta <= 0.5 pp, and survival >= 5%.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-105 Space stack, and the target variants across the three canonical snapshots.

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260511-105: Accepted RKLB/ASTS launch-connectivity 7 ATR trend target.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260511-106: Rejected LUNR/RDW lunar/manufacturing 7 ATR trend target.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260511-109: Rejected PL/BKSY trend risk scalar; any data-vendor retry must not be a risk-scalar retune.

hypothesis: PL/BKSY data-vendor trend_long winners may benefit from the same bucket-specific lifecycle convexity that improved RKLB/ASTS trend targets, while breakout risk haircuts and all other Space semantics stay fixed.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space forward event ledger still lacks enough mature closed decisions; this run uses deterministic OHLCV lifecycle replay.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby PL/BKSY trend target widths on the same frozen snapshots; future data-vendor Space work needs forward replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
